class.name: Wheel
class.brief_description: A vehicle wheel with suspension raycasting and tire-force simulation.
class.description: Wheel is a [Node3D] child of an [Axle]. Vehicle setup requires exactly two distinct wheels per axle. The wheel owns suspension contact state, tire forces, rotation, and an internally created raycast/skid-mark helper; only the bound read-only accessors below are part of the Godot API.

method.name: get_angular_velocity
method.description: Returns wheel angular velocity in radians per second.

method.name: get_tire_force
method.description: Returns the latest world-space tire force vector.

method.name: get_collision_point
method.description: Returns the latest world-space ground contact point.

method.name: get_collision_normal
method.description: Returns the latest world-space ground contact normal.

method.name: is_on_ground
method.description: Returns whether the suspension raycast currently contacts a surface.

method.name: get_slip_ratio
method.description: Returns the current longitudinal slip ratio.
